result.question: Quais são os 10 principais CIDs de entrada nas internações?
result.gold_sql: SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10;
result.generated_sql: SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10;
